title: Therapeutic Effect of Ethanol Extract of Propolis Against Osteoarthritis in a Mouse Model via Modulation of NF-kappaB and Hippo Signaling Pathways.
authors: Shi, Peiying; Zhang, Yi; Feng, Zhiyuan; Yang, Jiali; Wei, Lisha; Yao, Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜂胶乙醇提取物对骨关节炎的治疗作用，涉及NF-kappaB和Hippo信号通路，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是疾病治疗而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA), a chronic degenerative joint disease, leads to disability and increases the health burden. This study identified the chemical components in the ethanol extract of propolis (EEP) and investigated its effects and mechanism on monosodium iodoacetate-induced OA in mice. Three phenolic acid esters, alongside 16 flavonoids and their derivatives, were tentatively characterized in EEP using HPLC-MS, and four main components were quantified. EEP treatment alleviated pathological changes in articular cartilage and reduced serum CTX-II levels in OA mice. Network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted that pro-inflammatory cytokines (e.g., TNF-alpha) and apoptosis-related factors (e.g., Bcl-2) could be key targets for propolis treatment of OA-related diseases. Subsequently, EEP decreased serum TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 levels; increased the mRNA expression of Bcl-2; and reduced the mRNA expression of Caspase 8 and Bax in OA mice knee joints. Meanwhile, EEP decreased the mRNA expression of extracellular matrix-degrading enzymes in knee joints. Furthermore, through a combination of molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, RNA-seq, qRT-PCR, and Western blot assays, this study confirmed that EEP alleviated OA through regulating NF-kappaB and Hippo signaling pathways in the affected joints. These findings offer scientific evidence for the use of propolis in OA treatment.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种慢性退行性关节疾病，导致残疾并增加健康负担。本研究鉴定了蜂胶乙醇提取物（EEP）中的化学成分，并探讨了其对单碘乙酸诱导的小鼠OA的作用及机制。通过HPLC-MS，初步表征了EEP中三种酚酸酯及16种黄酮类化合物及其衍生物，并对四种主要成分进行了定量。EEP处理减轻了OA小鼠关节软骨的病理变化，并降低了血清CTX-II水平。网络药理学和分子对接预测，促炎细胞因子（如TNF-α）和凋亡相关因子（如Bcl-2）可能是蜂胶治疗OA相关疾病的关键靶点。随后，EEP降低了OA小鼠血清中TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6的水平；增加了膝关节中Bcl-2的mRNA表达；并降低了Caspase 8和Bax的mRNA表达。同时，EEP降低了膝关节中细胞外基质降解酶的mRNA表达。此外，通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、RNA-seq、qRT-PCR和Western blot实验相结合，本研究证实EEP通过调节受累关节中的NF-κB和Hippo信号通路来缓解OA。这些发现为蜂胶在OA治疗中的应用提供了科学依据。
